Author: U. Durga Prasad Rao
Bench: U. Durga Prasad Rao
 Hon'Ble Sri Justice U. Durga Prasad Rao
 Criminal Petition No.5329 Of 2019
Order:

The petitioners/A1 to A3 seek to quash the proceedings against them in Crime No.78 of 2019 of Ichapuram Town Police Station, Srikakulam District, which was registered against them for the offences under Sections 270, 272 and 273 of IPC and Section 20(2) of Cigarettes and Other Tobacco Products (Prohibition of Advertisement and Regulation of Trade and Commerce, Production,
Supply and Distribution) Act, 2003 (for short, 'COTP Act, 2003').
2.

sentences.text: The allegations against the petitioners briefly are that on 18.07.2019 at 20.00 hours, the complainant on receiving the credible information conducted vehicle check at Ichapuram Toll Plaza and seized Eicher Van bearing No.AP 37TD 7778 used for transporting banned tobacco products and also arrested the accused.
Hence, the FIR is registered for the offences under Sections 270, 272 and 273 of IPC and Section 20(2) of COTP Act.

3. Learned counsel for petitioners while denying the FIR allegations would submit that even if the prosecution case is accepted to be true, the Gutka which is a tobacco product would not fall within the definition of Section 3(j) of Food Safety Standards Act (for short, 'FSS Act') and therefore, the police are not authorized to register the crime and investigate and file charge sheet and therefore,
registration of the FIR is contrary to the provisions of FSS Act.
He relied upon the order of this Court in Crl.P.Nos.3731 and batch, dated 27.08.2018.

As can be seen, in the said common order a learned Judge of this Court partly allowed the criminal petitions and only quashed the offences punishable under Indian Penal Code and FSS Act, whereas permitted the respondents to proceed against the petitioners therein for the offences punishable under the provisions of COTP Act.

4. Following the above order and for the reasons recorded therein, this criminal petition is partly allowed and the proceedings initiated against the petitioners under Sections 270, 272 and 273 of IPC are hereby quashed and the respondents are permitted to proceed against the petitioners for the offences punishable under Section 20(2) of COTP Act, 2003.
As a sequel, miscellaneous petitions pending, if any, in this case shall stand closed.

_ U. DURGA PRASAD RAO, J 11.09.2019 SS A.Durga Rao vs State Of Ap on 11 September, 2019 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/173573637/
